command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/out && cd /tmp/out
# The PoseBusters paper's complexes (Astex Diverse 85 + PoseBusters Benchmark 428), Zenodo record
# 8278563 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.8278563), fetched on AWS and checked against Zenodo's published md5.
python3 -u - <<'PYEOF' || { echo "FAIL: fetch"; exit 1; }
import hashlib, urllib.request, zipfile
URL = "https://zenodo.org/records/8278563/files/posebusters_paper_data.zip?download=1"
WANT_MD5 = "f004ac7c4e68317b5348497d2bb6bee6"
md5 = hashlib.md5()
with urllib.request.urlopen(URL, timeout=600) as r, open("posebusters_paper_data.zip", "wb") as fh:
    while True:
        b = r.read(1 << 20)
        if not b:
            break
        md5.update(b); fh.write(b)
print("md5", md5.hexdigest(), "zenodo", WANT_MD5)
assert md5.hexdigest() == WANT_MD5, "md5 does not match Zenodo's published checksum"
z = zipfile.ZipFile("posebusters_paper_data.zip")
with open("listing.txt", "w") as fh:
    for i in z.infolist():
        fh.write("%d %s\n" % (i.file_size, i.filename))
print("entries", len(z.infolist()))
PYEOF
python3 -u - <<'PYEOF' || { echo "FAIL: results csv"; exit 1; }
import hashlib, urllib.request
URL = "https://zenodo.org/records/8278563/files/posebusters_paper_results.csv?download=1"
b = urllib.request.urlopen(URL, timeout=600).read()
assert hashlib.md5(b).hexdigest() == "a7cbe725e86e412fdfeb3c3e35c566dd", "results csv md5"
open("posebusters_paper_results.csv", "wb").write(b)
PYEOF
sha256sum posebusters_paper_data.zip posebusters_paper_results.csv | tee data.sha256
head -60 listing.txt
ls -l
echo DONE
